The main takeaway from our work is that

the coalescence picture for the formation of hypernucleus in the PLF in heavy ion collisions is not applicable, as the coalescence is a local process, whereas in the case of the hypernucleus formation in the PLF the coalescence occurs in a nonlocal way.
